# Hua Zhao · Reader-grounded NLP

> Researcher in NLP and linguistics. Language AI. Human meaning.

Content is available in static HTML without JavaScript. Record date: 2026-09-22.

Reader-grounded NLP is the umbrella concept; XHS-SCoRE and the cue-visibility audit are constituent studies.

Publication status, project stage and paper availability are separate fields.

In publication records, url is the publisher or preprint destination; page_url and project_urls identify pages on this site.

A null paper URL with paper_availability coming_soon means no public paper link is available.

Evidence records describe aggregate findings with units, scope and source availability.

## Reader-grounded NLP

- [Reader-grounded NLP](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/work/#reader-grounded-nlp): A research direction I develop with my collaborators, bringing the reader and their experienced meaning into NLP targets, benchmarks and model diagnostics.
- [XHS-SCoRE](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/work/xhs-score/): A benchmark of reader-perceived social comparison: 13,916 Chinese social-media posts, model comparisons and human validation.
- [Cue-visibility audit](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/work/cue-visibility/): A surface–neural audit of the cues models use to predict reader-perceived social comparison.

## Multilingual evaluation and supporting work

- [Prompt as Stratified Interface](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/work/prompt-interface/): A layered account of how instructions, labels and answer mappings shape multilingual model evaluation.
- [Language documentation](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/work/tanglang/): Doctoral research on Tanglang, an endangered Ngwi language, and contact-induced phonological change.

## Software and agent tooling

- [CiteVault](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/work/citevault/): Open-source software · v1.0.1. A self-hosted research library for checking human and AI writing against original papers, with traceable citations and access to specific pages.
- [EmailHub MCP](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/work/emailhub-mcp/): Open-source software · v0.1.0 preview. A self-hosted email workspace in Go, with bilingual search, a web interface and authenticated tools for AI assistants.
- [MONILite](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/work/monilite/): Open-source software. A compact Linux monitoring application with Python collection, SQLite history and a dashboard/API.

## Papers and citations

- [Psychologically Potent, Computationally Invisible: LLMs Generate Social-Comparison-Eliciting Posts They Fail to Detect](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/work/xhs-score/): EMNLP 2026 · Main conference · Accepted. [Preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01017). [BibTeX](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/citations/xhs-score.bib).
- [Hidden in Plain Text: A Cue-Visibility Audit for Reader-Perceived Social Comparison](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/work/cue-visibility/): NLPCC 2026 · Accepted. Paper coming soon. [BibTeX](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/citations/cue-visibility.bib).
- [Prompt as Stratified Interface: Decomposing Label-Mediated Effects in Chinese-English NLI](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/work/prompt-interface/): ORACLE 2026 · Workshop · Accepted. Paper coming soon. [BibTeX](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/citations/prompt-interface.bib).
- [The emotional valence paradox in social media: A computational linguistic analysis of how sentiment, emotion, and content domain predict social comparisons on Rednote](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/publications/#emotional-valence): International Journal of Applied Linguistics · Published · Advance online. [Publisher](https://doi.org/10.1111/ijal.70121). [BibTeX](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/citations/emotional-valence.bib).

- [Presentations](https://zhao4hua4.github.io/data/presentations.json): Conference records and direct material or abstract links.
